title: YouTube Uploader
summary: Let Claude upload videos when you ask, with separate channel profiles, thumbnail preparation, scheduled releases and safe resume after interruptions. Connect your own YouTube account once.
how_to_use: Install the skill, connect your own Google Desktop OAuth client, then ask Claude to upload a specific video and choose its visibility.
requires: Claude Code or Codex on macOS/Linux, Python and uv, your own YouTube channel and Google Cloud OAuth client. Configure storage paths for your computer.
